item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 18/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China gradually later tomorrow. It will be windy over the region early next week. A dry northeast monsoon is expected to bring generally fine weather to Guangdong midweek next week. It will be slightly cooler over the region in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, the broad area of low pressure over the western North Pacific will develop gradually and move towards the seas east of Luzon in the next few days. There are uncertainties in its subsequent movement.
